title: MWIR-4-Plastic: The Identification of Complex End-of-Life Industrial Plastic using Mid-wave Infrared Hyperspectral Imaging and Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2608.28874v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The automated sorting of shredded black plastics from end-of-life (EOF) industrial waste presents a significant challenge in recycling facilities, primarily due to the limitations of current sensing and analytical approaches. Existing studies predominantly rely on single-point contact-based mid-infrared spectroscopy or laboratory hyperspectral imaging (HSI) setups, which fail to provide the spatially resolved analysis necessary for fast, bulk processing. Moreover, available datasets are laboratory-controlled and focus on intact rather than shredded plastics, hindering further recycling refinement. Black industrial plastics, in particular, are underrepresented, while most classification pipelines depend on manual region selection and rule-based spectral matching, neglecting spatial information and modern deep learning (DL) methods. To address these gaps, we introduce the first publicly available HSI dataset of shredded black plastics fr

translated_title: MWIR-4-Plastic：利用中波红外高光谱成像与机器学习识别复杂的报废工业塑料
translated_abstract: 从报废工业废弃物中自动分选破碎黑色塑料是回收设施面临的重大挑战，其主要原因在于现有传感与分析方法的局限性。现有研究主要依赖单点接触式中红外光谱或实验室高光谱成像（HSI）设备，无法提供快速批量处理所需的空间分辨分析。此外，现有的数据集均在实验室受控条件下采集，且针对的是完整塑料而非破碎塑料，阻碍了回收工艺的进一步精细化。黑色工业塑料尤其缺乏代表性，而大多数分类流程依赖人工区域选择和基于规则的光谱匹配，忽略了空间信息和现代深度学习方法。为弥补这些不足，我们推出了首个公开可用的破碎黑色塑料HSI数据集……
tldr: 该研究发布了首个公开可用的破碎黑色工业塑料中波红外高光谱成像数据集，并结合机器学习方法解决了报废塑料自动分选中空间分辨分析缺失和黑色塑料代表性不足的问题。
en_tdlr: This study introduces the first publicly available mid-wave infrared hyperspectral imaging dataset of shredded black end-of-life industrial plastics and leverages machine learning to enable automated identification and sorting of complex plastic waste.
